summary: The trace shows the agent successfully completed the statistical analysis task but failed the legacy pytest suite. Key reusable lessons include: (1) scipy may not be available in execution environments, requiring pure-numpy implementations for Wilson confidence intervals and t-tests, (2) Excel date columns may be strings rather than datetime objects, requiring explicit parsing, (3) bug rate analysis with varying denominators needs special handling. This skill captures the statistical methods and failure-prevention patterns for future pipeline performance analysis tasks.
